title: Fix the Even Squares Comprehension
description: The program should build a list of squares of only the even numbers from 1 to 10. Fix the bug.
buggyCode:
squares = [n * n for n in range(1, 11)]
print(squares)
expectedBehavior: The program should print [4, 16, 36, 64, 100], the squares of the even numbers 2, 4, 6, 8, 10.
actualProblem: The comprehension squares every number from 1 to 10, with no filter condition to keep only the even ones, so odd numbers' squares are included too.
correctedCode:
squares = [n * n for n in range(1, 11) if n % 2 == 0]
print(squares)
explanation: A list comprehension only filters elements when an if clause is added after the loop portion. Without it, every value produced by range() is transformed and included.
